title: CWP/18314/2025 of GURPREET SINGH Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
aa io { 139 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision: 07.07.2025 GURPREET SINGH — eee eee Petitioner Versus STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS ~—__........ Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JAGMOHAN BANSAL Present: Mr. S.S. Brar, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Aman Dhir, DAG, Punjab. oR RK JAGMOHAN BANSAL, J. (Oral)

1. The petitioner through instant petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India is seeking direction to respondents to keep departmental proceedings in abeyance till the conclusion of criminal proceedings emanating out of FIR No.11 dated 02.03.2025, under Section 7 of Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 as amended by PC (Amendment) Act, 2018 and Section 61(2) of BNS, 2023 registered at Police Station Vigilance Bureau, Patiala (Annexure P-1).

2. Mr. S.S. Brar, Advocate for the petitioner submits that respondents may be directed not to proceed with departmental proceeding till the filing of police report under Section 193 of BNSS.

3. Mr. Aman Dhir, DAG, Punjab concedes that this Court in similar cases has directed to keep the departmental proceedings in abeyance till the filing of police report.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner agrees with aforesaid statement.

5. In the wake of statement of both sides, the present petition stands disposed of with a direction to respondent to keep departmental proceedings in abeyance till the date of filing of police report in aforesaid FIR. ( JAGMOHAN BANSAL ) JUDGE 07.07.2025 Ali
